concern_results.conclusion: Extraction reads only top-level error/*.failed events (message or error.message, deduped, whitespace-collapsed) and feeds the existing quota/auth greps alongside stderr with the CLI's actual `usage limit` wording added; fixtures map usage_limit_event and usage_limit_turn_failed to quota/true, auth_event to provider_unavailable/true, item-nested quota text to unknown_client_failure/false, and classifier order, precedence, and every existing reason code are unchanged, matching each acceptance row.

The receipt diagnostic is built solely from transport-authored top-level error messages; raw stderr has no path into the committed receipt; run-root and $HOME are replaced, URL userinfo and query strings are stripped before the shape-based key=value and quoted "key": "value" value redaction (key names no longer enumerated), sk-/Bearer/JWT shapes are removed, and the result is collapsed to one line and capped at 600 before emission; the success path adds no key.

Both python steps fail soft (OSError exits 0, per-line JSON errors skipped, 2>/dev/null), an empty builder result is replaced outside the builder by a fixed non-empty sentence so every post-run failure branch (timeout, signal, quota, auth, host-path, terminal unknown) carries the key, and PRESERVE_RUN_ROOT flips only inside the non-zero-run branch so the cleanup trap keeps the streams exactly on transport failure.

Every protected predicate has a discriminating row: event-stream quota/auth classification, the nested-item veto with a unique leak marker, redaction of compound/quoted/userinfo/query/home/run-root shapes with credential values assembled at runtime, the 600-char bound, truncation, stderr exclusion, the silent-failure fallback, run-dir preservation at mode 0700, and absence of both keys on success; the claimed RED baseline and four single-predicate mutations correspond one-to-one to what these assertions actually bind, with make test and the heavy lane cited green.

emit_inconclusive only appends two optional positionals defaulting to empty, so all pre-existing call sites are byte-identical; no flag, exit code, reason-code meaning, or CANDIDATE_LOCAL_CODES membership changes; both heredocs write to files at top level rather than nesting inside command substitution, removing the Bash 3.2 apostrophe parse trap, with /bin/bash -n evidence cited.

The change is additive within one wrapper plus its tests, register rows, and spec evidence; reverting restores prior behavior with no migration, no persisted state, and no consumer contract to unwind, since review_gate.py already relays wrapper-added receipt keys opaquely as it did for transport_exit_code; preserved run dirs fall to normal platform temp lifetime.

The evidence-destruction defect is repaired at its cause: the EXIT trap no longer deletes RUN_ROOT on failure, the receipt names the preserved directory (HOME-collapsed) via transport_run_dir, and transport_diagnostic records what the transport itself said — including an explicit sentence when it said nothing — so a wrong classification can no longer stand unfalsified as it did across rounds 122-123.

The steerable-verdict bypass is contained by restricting classifier input to top-level transport events (fixture proves packet-quoted item text yields unknown_client_failure/false, and the containment is mutation-executed), and the receipt-egress crossing is contained by removing arbitrary process output from the committed artifact rather than trusting the redactor, which remains only as documented defence in depth over CLI-authored input; the cascade set changes only in that genuine transport-reported quota/auth conditions are now recognized.
